description: Hello #TeamCastro! What a week! Honestly, I have been so busy with the campaign and being present in our beautiful community, that there's not enough room to include it ALL in this newsletter! And good news! If you weren't at the Volunteer Kickoff Party, you can see the full speeches from Dr. Eric Castater, Representative Lisa Campbell and me (Darcy!) on my YouTube channel. There was some REALLY great information shared here, so please take the time to watch and share with others! THANK YOU to all the volunteers who continue to show up - week after week - for our Wednesday volunteer group from 6-8pm at Kirkwood. This week we worked on postcards as well as completed our first service project for Cobb Collaborative - packing 250 book and craft kits for young readers! It was fun and rewarding! I hope you continue to join us for these weekly community building experiences. As we finalize postcards in the next few weeks, we will transition to phone banking (which is more fun when you're with friends!) and continued community service. This week, we will be collecting items for the KSU CARES Pantry, benefitting KSU students experiencing food insecurity. Check out the shopping list here. And finally, stay tuned, because I have some really exciting news to share soon! Darcy Castro Candidate for Georgia Senate District 37
title: News from Darcy Castro
